basics.name: Abimael Fernandez Ventura
basics.label: Full Stack Developer with Laravel, Vue, .NET and AWS
basics.summary: Full stack developer with a degree in Systems and Computer Engineering and 3+ years in web systems and integrations for Interbank and Scotiabank. As the sole developer, I built Tu Coach UDH, a course platform with more than 8,800 users.

work.name: Tecnovo Perú Soluciones S.A.C.
work.summary: Software consultancy. I built and deployed to the cloud systems for more than 5 of its clients.

work.name: Arsy Innova S.A.C.
work.summary: Education company behind Arsy Academy, for online courses, and Arsy Coworker, which connects companies with specialists.
highlights: Built the single account (SSO with OAuth2) that lets each user sign in to every platform.
Designed the architecture of the 4 platforms (Laravel 13, Vue 3, Docker) and put them into production, with Stripe and Mercado Pago payments.
Built Coworker with a team of 3, designed to cut handling time per request from 71 to about 9 business hours.

work.name: ABItech Perú E.I.R.L.
work.summary: Software company I founded, with its own products online and custom systems for education, healthcare and tourism clients.

work.name: OLSA
highlights: Built for Interbank, one of Peru's four largest banks, about 10 integration flows in IBM App Connect Enterprise, now in production, for its card system.
Took each integration from development to monitoring, with ESQL, CI/CD in Azure DevOps, Docker containers, testing in Postman and Bruno, and tracking in New Relic.

work.name: Universidad de Huánuco
work.summary: University lab where student teams build software for the institution.
highlights: Ran the lab and its computers. Under my lead, students built more than 10 projects for the university and the Huánuco regional tourism office.
Coordinated about 12 students on the Graduation Copilot, which digitizes the degree process, and automated its deployment.
Coordinated SmartLab, a QR-based system for lab entries and equipment bookings, which reached its testing phase.

work.name: Universidad de Huánuco
work.position: Full Stack Developer, Office of the Vice-Rector for Research
work.summary: Office that runs the university's research, with its grant calls, procedures and courses.

work.name: IT Corp Perú E.I.R.L.
highlights: Built the website and the DSpace 7 institutional repository of a teacher training school, required for its licensing by the Ministry of Education.
Built Gestión EVOL, a system where about 50 SAP consultants logged their hours and that calculated their payments.

publications.name: Contenedores con peras y manzanas
publications.summary: Colección para aprender Docker desde cero en español. Hay 7 volúmenes en borrador, con unas 140 000 palabras y un banco de pruebas que ejecuta cada comando del libro en la CI.

projects.name: Language learning LMS with subscriptions
projects.description: Subscription-based language learning platform (LMS), with payments through the Culqi payment gateway, SUNAT e-invoicing and AI grading.
highlights: Automated releases with CI/CD in GitHub Actions, with about 6 production releases a week.
Built AI grading (Gemini) for text, audio and video answers. It assessed 1,812 answers in 5 months.
Took the legacy system from 3 to 140 automated test files, so each new change would not break what already worked.
Rebuilt the billing history of 573 subscriptions inherited from the previous system, with no differences in the amounts.

projects.name: Gold pawn and trading system
projects.description: Gold pawn and trading system, with cash desks per branch, a vault and bank reconciliation.
highlights: Connected the system to the business's currency exchange software, so every transaction goes through the SBS anti-money laundering checks.
Integrated a fingerprint reader so each customer signs contracts and sworn statements with their fingerprint, as anti-money laundering rules require.
Wrote the tests for the daily check that screens customers against about 20,000 names on the UN and OFAC sanctions lists.
Restricted system access to authorized networks, so it cannot be used from outside the business.
Automated staging deployments, so the client could review changes about 6 times a week before production.
Sped up inventory lot withdrawals, with 42% fewer database queries.

projects.name: Offline maintenance reports PWA
projects.description: Installable web app (PWA), now in client testing, that lets technicians fill out and sign electrical maintenance reports on their phones, even without signal.
highlights: Built the offline mode, so technicians can work without signal and their reports, with encrypted signatures, sync without duplicates once back online.
Connected the app to the client's ERP so no data is lost or duplicated when a request fails.
Backed the app with over 1,800 automated tests, including 35 that walk through the full flow in the browser (E2E).

projects.name: Digital currency exchange platform
projects.description: Platform for a digital currency exchange supervised by the SBS, with identity verification (KYC) and generative AI-assisted anti-money laundering review.
highlights: Deployed the platform to the client's AWS account with Terraform (infrastructure as code), and a full environment is created in about 20 minutes, with no manual setup.
Adapted the .NET 10 API to run in containers on ECS Fargate with ARM processors and to work with PostgreSQL as well as SQL Server.
Fixed the precision of amounts in 38 database columns and the code that uses them, to prevent rounding errors.
Doubled the automated tests of the legacy API, from 130 to 274, so it could be changed with less risk.
Installed an adapted version of the platform for 2 more clients on Windows servers. Published the API and the web app on IIS with HTTPS and a free certificate, and managed SQL Server with SSMS.
Optimized the search for Peruvian location codes, which now reads 25 records instead of 2,077, 99% fewer.

projects.name: Pilot SSH
projects.description: Cloud service (SaaS), now in testing, that controls who accesses each server and records what they do, with an in-browser terminal.
highlights: Designed the REST API and the web terminal. Credentials are stored encrypted and the activity log cannot be altered.

projects.name: Recaudación Scotiabank
projects.description: Service for paying a municipality's taxes at Scotiabank, delivered and in certification.
highlights: Implemented in SOAP the 5 operations Scotiabank requires, with fixed-width messages similar to ISO 8583, and validated them with real bank messages.
Automated the packaging of each release, which stops if a test fails or if it finds a secret in the code.

projects.name: CRED+
projects.description: Web app (PWA) for growth monitoring, vaccines and family planning under Ministry of Health guidelines, with WhatsApp and email reminders.
highlights: Delivered the system in 6 days, ready for all 9,401 health facilities in Peru listed in the RENIPRESS registry.
Verified with the axe tool, at 7 screen sizes, that it has no accessibility violations under the WCAG 2.2 AA rules.
Redesigned reminders so their cost depends on pending notices, not on the number of registered mothers.

projects.name: Yachakuy
projects.description: Online course store (LMS) with the Mercado Pago payment gateway and QR-verifiable certificates.
highlights: Led 4 developers, with whom I took the platform to production and shipped about 3 releases a month, with a 96% success rate.

projects.name: La Frutería
projects.description: Sample app for my Docker books, which grows with each chapter.
highlights: Built the app with 5 Docker services, and each image ships signed and with a list of its components (SBOM).
Wrote 43 automated API, smoke and browser tests.

projects.name: Configuración de Claude Code
projects.description: Rules and validators I use to work with AI (Claude Code) the same way across all my projects.
highlights: Unified how I work with AI across 10 repositories, with validators covered by 19 automated tests.

projects.name: OptiPix
projects.description: My own version of Google's Squoosh, a web app that shrinks images right in the browser, without uploading them.
highlights: Added batch compression, to optimize many images at once and download them as ZIP files.

projects.name: Tu Coach UDH
projects.description: Online course platform (LMS) at Universidad de Huánuco on research and thesis writing.
highlights: Built it as the sole developer, and it has more than 8,800 users and more than 7,700 certificates issued across 4 courses.
Thesis students who used it improved their academic writing, according to a study with 60 of them.

projects.name: Hackathon UDH 2024
projects.description: Team registration system for the university hackathon.
highlights: Led a team of 4 that put the system into production in 3 weeks.

projects.name: SIGEP UDH
projects.description: Universidad de Huánuco system for calling for research projects and receiving applications.
highlights: I was its sole developer, and the university has run more than 10 grant calls on it, with over 150 applications and nearly 300 participants.

projects.name: Portal de Investigación UDH
projects.description: Research procedures portal for Universidad de Huánuco, with certificates, Turnitin, RENACYT and the university press.
highlights: I was its sole developer and kept maintaining it after leaving the role.

projects.name: Banco de Necesidades UDH
projects.description: Platform for recording the university's needs and receiving solution proposals from student teams.

projects.name: Psychological clinical records
projects.description: Clinical records system for a psychological trauma treatment service, with roles and two-factor authentication (2FA).

projects.name: abitech-payments-laravel
projects.description: Open-source Laravel package that integrates the Stripe and Mercado Pago payment gateways behind a single interface.
highlights: Designed it with the Strategy and Factory patterns so a new gateway can be added without touching the app, covered by 199 automated tests.

projects.name: Hostal Pacífico
projects.description: Bilingual website for a hostel, in Spanish and English, with its rooms and booking requests.
